LESSON: VIRTUES: IBADAH

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: AKHALAQ
Topic 5.1: Virtues: Ibadah

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Virtues: Ibadah
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: Why should a Muslim work?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
2. explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
3. describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings
4. appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Skill 1: state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam

Teach
• Today’s focus: state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam.
• Listen/read the idea.
• Watch/study the model.
• Then do Try this.

Worked example
• Model A for “state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam” using a school example.
• Model B for “state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam” using a home/county example.

Try this
• Your turn: show "state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam" in 3 bullet points.
• Share with a partner and improve one bullet.

▸ Skill 4: appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah

• Model B for “appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah” using a home/county example.

Try this

SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Model 1: state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
• Model 2: explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
• Model 3: describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings
• Model 4: appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. Practise: state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
2. Practise: explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
3. Practise: describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings
4. Practise: appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Make a one-page revision sheet for Virtues: Ibadah.
2. Teach someone at home for 2 minutes using bullet points only.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should a Muslim work?
2. Why is work considered an act of Ibadah?
3. What kind of work is prohibited in Islam?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• state the reasons why work is considered as Ibadah in Islam
• explain the benefits of work in the development of the Ummah
• describe different types of work as means to lawful earnings
• appreciate the importance of work as a form of Ibadah
